880-8337-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-8337-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

678-4939-6798.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying its mana cost.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary.
When Burning-Tree Emissary dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

2736-5571-8095--6.description:
Use Zedruu the Greathearted to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

849-2438-2738-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5078-6650-7913.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2021-2060-3921-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

3821-4415-6751.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4415-6751.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2741-5641-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2741-5641-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

4013-4659-5004-6643-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
4013-4659-5004-6643-7693.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2511-4694-7652.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2724-5780-6432.notablePrerequisites:
Gossip's Talent is level 3.
Wormfang Manta doesn't have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-5780-6432.description:
Declare the creature you wish to blink as an attacker, attacking an opponent that cannot block it.
When that creature deals damage, Gossip's Talent's last ability triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Doorkeeper Thrull.
Repeat each turn.

When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.

141-698-7301.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 2 or more life this turn.
141-698-7301.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Avatar's Wrath by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Will.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Avatar's Wrath
Resolve Avatar's Wrath, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Will.
Repeat from step 4.

512-4241-7287.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2921-6909.description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. 
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Carnage.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Carnage.
When Carnage dies, Saffi triggers, returning Carnage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Carnage enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

372-1309-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1309-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

880-2653-7201.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.

Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

104-4659-4772-5086-5183.description:

Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

Activate Marvin using Wirewood Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

803-2366-5147-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.

When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding {3}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

640-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
640-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.

You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

575-1207-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.

Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

Freed from the Real attached to Othelm.

Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Othelm.
Repeat.

When The One Ring enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain protection from everything until your next turn.
Activate Jace's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, returning The One Ring to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat during each of your turns.

549-1558-1692-2567.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Avenger of Zendikar.
You control at least four lands.
549-1558-1692-2567.description:

The Avenger of Zendikar token triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Thornbite Staff attached to Avatar of Woe.
Avatar of Woe does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4698.description:
Activate Avatar of Woe by tapping it, destroying target creature.
The creature dies, triggering Avatar of Woe, untapping it.

You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield.

643-4302-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4302-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another creature.

When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1975-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Hargilde.
Hargilde does not have summoning sickness.
1975-3263-3525.description:
Activate Hargilde by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first activated ability by paying {1}, untapping Hargilde.
Repeat.

618-4125-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn.
Shipwreck Dowser triggers, getting +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser with haste.
The token copy of Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

225-3756-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3756-4222.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
